data.description:
Rebecca Keagan has always been the standard wife and mother of 4 living in suburban New Jersey. Always the diligent hard worker, She has always contributed to her share of the household income working as a corporate manager in Manhattan. With a stable marriage going over 20 years she was living the true American dream until fate hit the Keagans with a hard blow. Within the 2 weeks, both Rebecca and her husband Bill lost their jobs due to company cut backs. after weeks of job hunting, Rebecca was able to get a new job as a teacher in a predominately black, inner city, high school where not too many teachers are willing to work at. Now stressed with the burden of being the only source of income for the family, she currently works at the school teaching senior students to this day as her husband continues to struggle to find employment.
